thread:
Asha (CS): Week0 smoke check for SagePoint private deploy — quick status. Most things green but two blockers: audit logs are missing some request identity fields and our KMS rotation script failed due to alias mismatch. Ping @Kai and @Liam for triage. I'll capture actions + renewal risk if not cleared by EOW. :wave:

Kai (Platform): On it. Can you paste an example log line and the rotation error?

Asha (CS): Sure — sample log (redacted):
```
{
  \"eventTime\": \"2026-02-14T09:12:34Z\",
  \"eventName\": \"StartInstances\",
  \"userIdentity\": {
    \"type\": \"AssumedRole\",
    \"arn\": \"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/SagePointCrossAcct/DeployRole\"
    // missing: requestUserIdentity.sessionContext (expected)
  },
  \"requestParameters\": {},
  \"responseElements\": null
}
```

Asha (CS): Rotation error from the script: `Error: KMS alias "alias/sagepoint-prod-enc" not found` — our key alias in account is `alias/sagepoint-prod-enc-2025` (rotation automation expects the short name).

Liam (Security): The missing sessionContext suggests the logger role might be assuming logs without full principal info — two guesses: CloudTrail is delivering minimalEventData or the delivery account is stripping fields. Can you confirm CloudTrail config includes Read/Write events and the trail is set to include global service events? Also check whether logs are routed through a log-delivery role that assumes no session tags.

Kai (Platform): I ran the smoke script locally against the staging mirror. DeployBot reported: 18/20 checks passed; 2 failed (audit fields, kms alias). DeployBot output: `smoke-suite — FAILED (2)` :eyes:

DeployBot: smoke-runner: 1785054321 | checks: network:ok iam:ok kms:fail audit:fail -- see details in artifact: https://artifacts.redwood/sagepoint/week0/1785054321

Asha (CS): Thanks. Proposed plan: 1) Kai will update the rotation script to accept the date-suffixed alias and add a validation step; 2) Liam will validate CloudTrail/delivery role config and confirm if sessionContext is preserved in the logging account; 3) If we can't clear both by EOW (Fri 18:00 PT) I will mark a medium renewal risk and schedule a solutions call with the customer next Tue.

Kai (Platform): I can push a quick patch for the rotation (v0.1) by EOD today and add a fallback alias matcher. I'll also add a small unit test to avoid regressions.

Liam (Security): I'll check CloudTrail and the log delivery role; if it's the delivery pipeline (Splunk/Fluentd) dropping fields we need to update the onboarding runbook to require `includeManagementEvents: true` and explicit sessionContext passthrough. Expect update by tomorrow noon.

Asha (CS): Action owners noted. I'll DM the customer (SagePoint Ops) a one-line summary and ask for slack access to their logging account if needed. Also tagging renewal: if both items remain open after Friday we escalate. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Kai (Platform): Quick note — network smoke showed egress to Splunk collector needs TLS SNI to be allowed; I added an exception in the private gateway policy for now (temporary).

Asha (CS): Noted. I'll include that in the runbook snapshot. Meeting? 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to review fixes and decide on escalation. Everyone OK?

Liam (Security): Works for me.

Kai (Platform): Yep. I'll bring the patch link and smoke artifacts.

Asha (CS): Great — thanks team. I'll follow up with a short summary and assign JIRA tasks.

DeployBot: reminder: weekly-health-scan scheduled for 2026-02-16T15:00:00Z

Asha (CS): Last note — tagging this thread as "week0-health" in the customer folder and adding to the renewal watchlist until cleared.
